_provenance.what: REAL ledger rows + REAL L1 truth for the flux-rope-v1 daily validation loop, Aug 26 - Sep 19 2026.
_provenance.source: Supabase aijsboodkivnhzfstvdq (production): cme_arrival_forecasts (flux-rope-v1 + the enlil/dbm-v1/ballistic-v1 baselines), cme_l1_observations, sw_geomag_dataset (NOAA SWPC RTSW 1-min L1). Pulled 2026-10-11. The NASA DONKI CME kinematics each lock used are frozen inside its inputs.
_provenance.integrity: bz.windows[].md5 and locks_md5 were computed SERVER-SIDE in Postgres over the same canonical encodings; tests/flux-rope-ledger-real.mjs recomputes both, so a transcription error fails the gate.
_provenance.bz_encoding: 2 chars per minute, base64url alphabet (A-Z a-z 0-9 - _), code = round(bz*10)+2048 (0.1 nT steps); code 4095 ('__') = gap (null or sw_flag='gap').
_provenance.locks_digest: md5 over rows ordered (event_id, issued_at) of event_id|floor(issued ms)|floor(predicted ms)|v0_kms|w_eff_kms|round(gamma*1e10)|launch|epoch|p_hit, joined by newline

vFirstHour.note: RTSW speed (sw_flag=ok, km/s rounded) for the 61 minutes from each observed shock; null = flagged/missing.

upstreamV6h.note: median RTSW speed (sw_flag=ok, km/s) over [shock-6h, shock-10min) — the ambient wind the CME was decelerating into; n=350 minutes each
